# Priscilla Grant

[Academy](../codex/places.md#academy)

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale and spiritual-looking maiden. Despite her delicate appearance, she possesses a lively nature full of mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Priscilla Grant is a thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) student who forms part of a close circle of friends. Though she appears as a pale and spiritual-looking maiden, she is actually full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Priscilla Grant became a close friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy). Together with their friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), they adjusted to student life and shared academic pursuits. As final examinations and commencement approached in the spring, Priscilla joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their friends in discussing their upcoming tests and reflecting on their efforts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
